metadata.title: Moldova ERAA: electricity supply and demand regions (network-based partition)
metadata.derived_from: Moldova_regions_full_partition.pdf: Ministry of Energy 110-400 kV network map, each point assigned to the region whose 110 kV network (lines and substations) is nearest; regions A-F confined to the right bank of the Dniester; Dnestroenergo covers the left bank and the Bender area
metadata.georeferencing: Map registered to official boundaries with a cubic polynomial plus thin-plate-spline rubber sheet anchored on the national border and the Dniester; independent check on 28 town substations: median 2.0 km, 90th percentile 4.7 km
metadata.national_border_and_dniester: Snapped to official boundaries: geoBoundaries gbOpen MDA ADM1 (boundaryID MDA-ADM1-25212430; source UNHCR, OCHA FISS; CC BY 3.0 IGO). Left bank = Stinga Nistrului ATU plus the left-bank part of Dubasari raion (split along Natural Earth 10m Dniester)
metadata.accuracy_note: Internal boundaries between regions follow the network-based partition and are approximate (typically within about 2 km); external border and the Dniester follow official boundaries
